title: Drag Race Simulator
description: A data-driven simulation modeling contestant scoring and elimination logic.

about: Built to explore how structured data and a handful of scoring rules can recreate the drama of an elimination-based reality competition — episode-by-episode placements, running point totals, and a bottom-of-the-pack cutoff that decides who's safe.

The devlog series covers the build itself: how the scoring schema came together, what the track-record data looks like under the hood, and the decisions behind turning a season's worth of placements into something simulatable.
Race along Saturn's rings, dodging debris and firing back. Survive each wave, chase a high score, and face the boss at the end of the belt.

controls.how: Left-thumb joystick on touch screens, or arrow keys / WASD
